# MetaForge for a hosted gateway

**Generated by `scripts/build_integrations.py` — do not edit by hand.**

The same skills, commands, agents and hooks as `claude-code/`, with the connector already pointing at the hosted gateway (`https://mcp.metaforge.uk/mcp`). There is nothing to enter. This is an experiment (FORGE-661): the address is a literal so claude.ai does not ignore the connector, and so it can match a connector you added with the same address.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add FidelOdok/MetaForge
/plugin install metaforge-cloud
```

It is listed in the open-core marketplace until the hosted service publishes a marketplace of its own (FORGE-707).

Run `/mcp`, choose `metaforge`, and sign in with the access secret your administrator gave you. There is no token field: the gateway answers 401 and Claude Code runs OAuth. The gateway needs `METAFORGE_OAUTH_LOGIN_SECRET` set.

### On claude.ai

Open the plugin's **Connectors** tab. Adding a plugin does not add or sign in its connector: **Add** it, then **Connect**. If it cannot be added, add a custom connector under **Customize → Connectors** with the same address, typed with no punctuation after it. Chat ignores agents and hooks; Cowork loads agents.

## Which package

| | `metaforge-cloud` | `metaforge` | `metaforge-local` |
|---|---|---|---|
| For | the hosted gateway | any gateway, local by default | no gateway |
| Address | written in | you enter it, local default | none |

Install **one**. The manifest has no way to switch a server entry off, so two packages would offer every tool twice.

## Skills

45 skills are bundled.

## Agents

- `metaforge-flow-planner`
- `metaforge-run-verifier`

## Hooks

PostToolUse, SessionStart: the working rules at session start, and a reminder when a flow proposal or patch is held for a person. Python 3 on the PATH; `METAFORGE_PLUGIN_HOOKS=off` disables them.

## Writes wait for a human

A tool that writes is held for approval, because the hosted gateway sees you as a remote caller. Held calls appear on the dashboard's Approvals page.
